tips.text: Buy extra Neuroptics relics; it is the Rare part in every one of them.
Bank Aya before the window opens; neither Aya nor relics expire when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab of the Market on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine the Uncommon and Rare relics to Radiant and run a radshare squad to crack them.
Leave the Systems relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Pick the same reward as a teammate at the reward screen; they get bonus Void Traces.
